name: ResearchRabbit
insight: Commits to keeping a feature-complete tier free forever; the paid RR+ tier is purchasing-power-parity priced across 100+ countries.
tagline: Citation-based literature mapping that visualizes how papers connect.
description: A literature-discovery tool for researchers that maps the scholarly landscape instead of returning flat result lists. Start from one or more "seed" papers and it surfaces related work, citing/cited papers, and relevant authors as an interactive network — drawing on 270M+ papers — so connections appear even when articles don't cite each other directly. Collections sync to Zotero and can trigger new-paper alerts.

modelSupport.notes: Citation-network recommendations over 270M+ papers — a discovery graph, not an LLM chatbot.

edge: Spotify-style visual citation maps from a seed paper surface related work even when papers don't cite each other directly.
pros: Free Forever tier is genuinely usable
Visual citation and author network maps
cons: Not an LLM Q&A or summarizer
No full-text PDF reading or analysis
Seed-input cap on the free tier

references.title: Streamlining Your Literature Review Workflow with ResearchRabbit
